# Vendored animation runtimes

- GSAP 3.15.0 and ScrollTrigger, copied from greensock/GSAP commit 13e2b790546426a1a2e0e9b409f3f8dc6d6611f2, dist/*.min.js. Copyright notices retained. License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
- Lenis 1.3.27, https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.3.27/dist/lenis.min.js. MIT license in Lenis.LICENSE.txt. Source reference: darkroomengineering/lenis commit e01eefb1f55cd08bc051521d74f5f8182b71ee9d.
- Files are served locally; no CDN is required at runtime. No package manager or build step added.
